template.name: Minecraft Server Properties
template.description: Configure core Minecraft server settings (MOTD, gamemode, difficulty, player cap, PvP, whitelist, view distance, online mode), optionally enable RCON with a generated password, and optionally accept the Minecraft EULA.

variables.label: Server MOTD
variables.description: Message of the day shown in the Minecraft multiplayer server list.

variables.label: Default Gamemode
variables.description: Game mode assigned to new players joining the server.

variables.label: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of concurrent players allowed online.

variables.label: Enable PvP
variables.description: Allow players to damage each other.

variables.label: Enable Whitelist
variables.description: Only allow players listed in whitelist.json to connect.

variables.label: View Distance
variables.description: Number of chunks sent to clients in each direction.

variables.label: Online Mode
variables.description: Verify players against Mojang authentication servers. Disable only behind a proxy.

variables.label: Enable RCON
variables.description: Enable remote console access with an automatically generated 24-character password.

variables.label: RCON Port
variables.description: TCP port RCON listens on when RCON is enabled.

variables.label: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Write eula=true to eula.txt, confirming agreement to the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA).

steps.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
Write server.properties
Append RCON port and generated password
